option_relations.rationale: Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma (PTC) is a subtype of Vascular Thyroid Cancer (VTC), and the option specifies metastasis, aligning with the leaf.
Metastatic Vascular Thyroid Carcinoma is directly equivalent to Vascular Thyroid Cancer (VTC) with Metastasis, as VTC is a type of vascular thyroid carcinoma.

Radioiodine-refractory vesicular thyroid carcinoma (VTC) with sinonasal metastasis is a specific description that falls under the umbrella of Vascular Thyroid Cancer (VTC) with Metastasis, and the vignette supports the radioiodine-refractory nature and sinonasal metastasis.
Follicular Thyroid Carcinoma is another subtype of Vascular Thyroid Cancer (VTC), and the option specifies metastasis, aligning with the leaf.
